name: Game Opening Cutscene
description: An intense opening cutscene showing Max being dressed in a security guard uniform with equipment before being trapped in Candy World.

scenes.name: Darkness and Confusion
scenes.description: Max regains consciousness in complete darkness. Confused groaning sounds. Screen is black with subtle breathing audio.

dialogue.max_internal: Where... where am I? What happened?

scenes.name: The Security Office
scenes.description: Scene fades in showing a dark security office. Max is sitting in a chair, dazed. A security uniform is laid out on a table in front of him. A figure in shadows approaches.

scenes.name: Mysterious Voice
scenes.description: A distorted, mechanical voice speaks to Max from the shadows. The figure remains unseen.

dialogue.mystery_voice: Max... you've been chosen. Put on the uniform. You'll need it.

scenes.name: Dressing Up - Shirt
scenes.description: Max, compelled by fear, reaches for the security shirt. Camera shows him putting on the dark blue uniform shirt with 'SECURITY' printed on the back.

scenes.name: Dressing Up - Vest
scenes.description: Max puts on the tactical bullet vest. It's heavy and intimidating. The vest has multiple pockets and reinforced plating.

scenes.name: Pants and Belt
scenes.description: Max stands and puts on the reinforced security pants with a heavy duty belt designed to hold equipment.

scenes.name: The Hat
scenes.description: Max picks up the security cap with bold 'SECURITY' lettering across the front. He places it on his head with trembling hands.

scenes.name: Equipping - Baton
scenes.description: A baton is placed on the table. Max picks it up, testing its weight. It's heavy and solid - designed for combat.

scenes.name: Equipping - Taser
scenes.description: A taser is placed before Max. He hesitantly picks it up. The device hums with electric potential. He attaches it to his belt.

scenes.name: The Final Piece
scenes.description: The mystery figure steps partially into view - still mostly shadowed. Places a final item: a badge that says 'SECURITY GUARD - CANDY WORLD FACILITY'

dialogue.mystery_voice: Welcome to Candy World, Security Guard. You have 15 days. Survive if you can.

scenes.name: Fully Equipped
scenes.description: Camera pans over Max's full equipped body. He's now wearing the complete security uniform - shirt, pants, vest, hat, with baton and taser visible. He looks terrified but determined.

scenes.name: The Door Opens
scenes.description: A large door to the facility opens before Max. Bright colorful lights flood in - clashing with the darkness of the security office. Max hears distant carnival music and children's laughter... but something is deeply wrong about it.

scenes.name: Step Into Darkness
scenes.description: Max takes a first step into Candy World. The door slams shut behind him with a terrifying finality. The cheerful carnival atmosphere is revealed to be a thin veneer over something sinister.

scenes.name: Radio Contact
scenes.description: Max's security radio crackles to life. A calm, professional voice breaks through - it's iassc making first contact from outside the facility.

dialogue.iassc_radio: Max, can you hear me? I'm iassc. I've hacked into their comms. Listen carefully - you need to survive the next 15 days. Trust no one but me. We'll get you out of there.

scenes.name: Game Begins
scenes.description: Fade to black. Text appears: 'DAY 1 - 06:00' and the game officially begins.

lore_context.why_security_uniform: Max was somehow forced into this role. The facility wanted him disguised as security, perhaps to trick him or to make the horror more ironic.
lore_context.weapons_are_illusion: The baton and taser give Max false confidence, but they prove mostly useless against the animatronics. Real survival comes from hiding and evading.
lore_context.fake_authority: The uniform and badge make Max feel like he has authority, but he has none. He's just a prisoner in a costume.
lore_context.psychological_setup: Being dressed as security makes the betrayal and helplessness even more psychologically damaging when Max realizes the weapons and uniform mean nothing.
